title: doctor re-keying — explore checks keyed on grove-explore registration, not mode

plan.objective: Re-key `grove doctor` so explore checks run only on `grove-explore` registration, add two-registration drift detection plus stale-layout hint, and remove orphaned `--explore`/`--standard` flags conservatively.
key_changes: Re-key explore group trigger from `mode == McpLlm` to `grove-explore` registration in any selected harness.
Add registration-detection helper scanning all harness configs (Claude, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, Windsurf, VS Code).
Extend harness-consistency drift matrix for two-registration layout and stale single-registration layout.
Emit stale-layout hint to re-run `grove init --as mcp-llm` when old `--explore` arg is found.
Remove `--explore`/`--standard` flags from `grove doctor` and delete force plumbing in `cli/src/main.rs`.
Keep `ModeChoice::None` and `active_mode` in `core/src/config.rs`; only drop `ForceExplore`/`ForceStandard` variants.
Leave `core/src/lib.rs` and `cli/src/init.rs` untouched because the conservative path preserves their public API.
Remove `core/src/config.rs` unit tests covering the deleted force variants.
Update `core/src/doctor.rs` tests for registration gating, drift rows, and a non-Claude/multi-harness fixture.
Preserve structural checks, `--json` shape, exit-code gate, and mark the change material for version bump.

review_plan.objective: Re-assessed the revised GROVE-S04-T07 plan after the prior revision-required verdict, verifying the conservative ModeChoice/active_mode path and the named multi-harness explore-registration fixture.
key_changes: Required Change #1 resolved: §4 takes the conservative path (drop only ForceExplore/ForceStandard, keep ModeChoice::None + active_mode); lib.rs:68 and init.rs:1602/1612 correctly left unmodified.
Empirically verified the conservative path is clippy-clean: a single-variant enum matched with a single named arm does NOT trip clippy::match_single_binding under -D warnings.
Required Change #2 resolved: §5 and Testing Strategy now explicitly name a multi-harness/non-Claude mcp-llm fixture (grove-explore registered only in Cursor).
Building blocks verified present: harness::EXPLORE_SERVER_KEY, expected_explore_args, check_harness_registration, read_grove_args, McpFormat across all 6 harnesses (mcpServers/servers/Codex TOML).
Current explore trigger is a single 'if mode == McpLlm' arm at the tail of diagnose; re-keying to registration presence is a one-line gate change.
check_harness_serve_surface already accepts a has_explore_cfg bool; repointing to registration presence is mechanical.
Crate layering preserved: core (grove-cst) has no grove-explore-core dependency; cli already has it but plan adds none.
Spec compliance: all 5 ACs mapped; plan widens trigger beyond literal '.mcp.json' AC text to any selected harness, the agreed harness-agnostic direction.
Doctor deletes --explore/--standard outright (no error-guard) vs T03's hidden error-guard; justified since doctor has no successor binary; §4 states this.
Plugin impact correct: version bump flagged material; migration entry N/A (read-only); no schema change; no security scan needed.
Carried advisory: docs/doctor-command-proposal.md will go stale after flag removal; out of sprint scope (item 9), noted as Known Doc Debt.

implementation.objective: Re-keyed `grove doctor` so explore checks run only on `grove-explore` registration, added two-registration drift detection plus stale-layout hint, and removed orphaned `--explore`/`--standard` flags.
key_changes: Re-keyed the explore check group trigger from `mode == McpLlm` to presence of a `grove-explore` registration in any selected harness.
Added harness-agnostic `has_explore_registration` helper scanning all six harness configs (Claude, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, Windsurf, VS Code).
Extended per-harness registration checks to validate both structural `grove` and explore `grove-explore` entries against the declared mode.
Added stale-layout detection that flags any `grove` entry still containing the removed `--explore` argument and hints `grove init --as mcp-llm`.
Updated `harness_serve_surface` to report Standard/Explore based on explore-registration presence rather than mode inference.
Removed `--explore`/`--standard` flags and force plumbing from `Cmd::Doctor` in `cli/src/main.rs`.
Conservatively pruned `ModeChoice` in `core/src/config.rs` to only `None`, keeping `active_mode` for API compatibility.
Removed obsolete `ModeChoice::ForceExplore`/`ForceStandard` unit tests and renumbered remaining active_mode tests.
Added unit tests for registration gating, non-Claude multi-harness `mcp-llm` fixtures, stale-layout detection, unexpected explore entries, and missing explore entries.
Strengthened `cli/tests/cli.rs::doctor_help_documents_verb` to assert removed flags are absent from `--help`.

AC4 met: --explore/--standard removed from Cmd::Doctor; ModeChoice pruned to None only; active_mode retained for API compat; all callers pass None.
AC5 met: clippy -D warnings clean; 15 doctor tests pass (5 new); doctor_help_documents_verb passes; files end with newline.
